tool: ChatGPT 桌面版 codex 内置出图（gen_hero.sh）
notes: 人物设定：男的魁梧粗犷、胡子茬；女的妩媚、丰胸细腰。turnaround 是四面设定图（只做参考），portrait 进行装页和立命籍，frames 进 pack_frames.py。 女角三张图出图时附上男角同一张图当画风样板（ref），画风、质感、像素粗细要和男角一致，头身比约 7.5 头身。 fullbody-female 是行装页的全身正面像（附男角全身像当画风样板、女角四面图当设计样板），跑 pack_portraits.py fullbody-female 进游戏；女角腿长按正常比例写死，避免出图拉长腿。

turnaround-male.png.prompt: Use case: character-design. Original character model sheet / turnaround for a dark Chinese-folklore 2D action game. The SAME character drawn four times, full body head to toe, side by side in one row at identical scale with equal spacing, relaxed standing pose, arms slightly away from the body: (1) front view, (2) three-quarter view, (3) strict side profile facing right, (4) back view. Plain flat warm-grey background. Adult Chinese Daoist exorcist man, late thirties, a towering burly and rugged brawler: very broad heavy shoulders, thick neck, barrel chest, big muscular arms and thick forearms, square heavy jaw covered in short coarse black stubble (several days unshaven, stubble also on the upper lip and chin, NOT a full beard), heavy brows, deep-set hard eyes, weathered sun-browned skin, faint scar across one cheek, black hair tied in a rough messy topknot with a few loose strands. Weathered ink-black cross-collar Ming-inspired travelling coat worn a little open at the collar showing part of the chest, cool bone-white diagonal lapel, sleeves rolled to the elbow with layered grey cloth forearm wraps, high split knee-length coat over loose charcoal trousers and heavy black cloth boots, torn muted indigo waist sash trailing behind, one small aged bronze talisman plaque hanging at the belt. Dressed for a cold mountain pilgrimage. Refined hand-painted graphic-novel / anime facial treatment with restrained realistic Chinese features, beautiful subtle texture in cloth, skin and hair, dark painterly render, thin sharp lines and natural muted colour, smoky pewter highlights and a little warm ember light. Black mythic Chinese folklore world. No text, no labels, no arrows, no frame, no weapons, no effects.

frames-male.png.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A production 2D game sprite sheet containing exactly 12 distinct animations of the SAME character, arranged as a strict 4 columns × 3 rows evenly spaced regular grid, landscape 3:2 canvas. Transparent background, no gridlines, no borders, letters or labels. All figures small enough to fit completely inside an equal cell with transparent gaps on every side, feet near each cell's own bottom, every figure the same height (about 80% of a cell). True crisp 32-bit era pixel clusters with a fine pitch, muted charcoal palette and restrained sepia rim light, hard pixels, game sprite silhouette rather than miniature illustration. Orthographic SIDE view, facing screen RIGHT in every cell, same human scale and clothes in every pose. Adult Chinese Daoist exorcist man, late thirties, a towering burly and rugged brawler: very broad heavy shoulders, thick neck, barrel chest, big muscular arms and thick forearms, square heavy jaw covered in short coarse black stubble (several days unshaven, stubble also on the upper lip and chin, NOT a full beard), heavy brows, deep-set hard eyes, weathered sun-browned skin, faint scar across one cheek, black hair tied in a rough messy topknot with a few loose strands. Weathered ink-black cross-collar Ming-inspired travelling coat worn a little open at the collar showing part of the chest, cool bone-white diagonal lapel, sleeves rolled to the elbow with layered grey cloth forearm wraps, high split knee-length coat over loose charcoal trousers and heavy black cloth boots, torn muted indigo waist sash trailing behind, one small aged bronze talisman plaque hanging at the belt. Dressed for a cold mountain pilgrimage. The body shape must read clearly in silhouette. Exactly these poses in reading order: row 1 [upright idle, walking front-leg stride, walking back-leg stride, low braced ready stance]. Row 2 [weight on back foot preparing a strike with hands held back by right shoulder, lunging forward with both hands together extended horizontally to screen right, bent front knee following through with both hands low and forward, pulling hands back upright recovering]. Row 3 [low backward dodge with shoulders back and knees compressed, recoil as if punched in chest, with right hand extended in a talisman spell, walking passing pose feet closer]. Hands visible and clenched as if gripping a thin invisible handle; absolutely no weapons or VFX in the sprites, game draws weapons separately. No ground, no ground shadow, no colored background. Each of the 12 cells contains one whole independent figure from head to toes, never overlaps other cells. Use the same true pixel-art rendering in all cells.
